provenance.author: Devin using GLM-5.2
provenance.content_origin: Devin manually constructed tactical positions and verified them mechanically
provenance.method: Manually constructed board positions via setup_moves. Each probe reaches a position where the expected action is mechanically verifiable by the Connect4Env.would_win() check. Positions were verified by replaying setup_moves and checking the claim against the environment's own verifier.
provenance.note: These probes exercise the verifier and harness only. They are not training labels, not held-out evaluation data, and not a frontier model's output. They exist to prove the environment correctly detects immediate wins and blocks.

probes.description: X has three in a row horizontally at the bottom (columns 1-3). Playing column 4 completes four in a row.
X has three vertical pieces in column 1. Playing column 1 again completes four in a column.
O has three in a row horizontally at the bottom (columns 1-3). X must play column 4 to block O's immediate win.
O has three vertical pieces in column 1. X must play column 1 to block O's immediate vertical win.
